item.title: Myanmar recalls ambassador to Thailand for questioning
item.description: Myanmar has recalled its ambassador to Thailand for questioning, reportedly in connection with the transport of migrant workers into the country.

item.title: Ex-minister given death sentence for murder of adopted son
item.description: The Criminal Court has sentenced former cabinet minister Soonthorn Vilawan, 87, to death for the murder of a Prachin Buri councillor who was his adopted son. The sentence was commuted to life imprisonment.

item.title: Chearavanont family gives condo to AGT winner Nene Royal
item.description: Thailand’s second-richest family has given a 98-square-metre luxury condominium to the family of young Thai rocker Nene Royal, who made history on Thursday as the first Thai to win “America’s Got Talent”.

item.title: MP and actor among 34 targeted for forex scam prosecution
item.description: People’s Party MP Pawoot Pongvitayapanu and actor Rattapoom Tokongsup are among 34 suspects the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) is seeking to indict in a high-profile foreign-exchange scam case.

item.title: Visitor goes missing in flooded Pattaya
item.description: PATTAYA - A man believed to be a foreigner went missing after his group fell into a canal while they were wading through a flooded alley in this tourist city early Thursday morning.

item.title: Traffy Fondue to expand its reach across govt agencies
item.description: The Traffy Fondue platform has been adopted as a central government service for reporting and managing urban problems, the Minister of Higher Education, Science, Research and Innovation, Yodchanan Wongsawat, said.

item.title: Sondhi asks public to turn out for EC complaint
item.description: Protest leader Sondhi Limthongkul and allies are urging the public to join them in filing a complaint with the Election Commission (EC) tomorrow over Senate election collusion.

item.title: DSI head appointment raises PP ire
item.description: The opposition has raised concerns over the appointment of Pol Capt Piya Raksakul as the new director-general of the Department of Special Investigation (DSI), warning the agency could be turned into a political tool or used to benefit people facing criminal charges.

item.title: Thai students exempt from new Australian visa measures
item.description: Australian authorities have reaffirmed that Thai students will be exempt from new visa measures affecting international students, while seeking closer cooperation with Thailand on trade, migration and regional security.

item.title: PP 'has no shield' for probe MPs
item.description: The People's Party (PP) will not shield MPs Pawoot Pongvitayapanu or Somchart Techathavorncharoen with parliamentary immunity if evidence links them to wrongdoing, said the party leader.
